The '''B-20 rifle blaster''', manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]], was a type of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] available during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems (CIS)]].<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>

The B-20 rifle had a pressure-wiped stock.<ref name=":0" />

*''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]'' {{1st}}
